description: Covers B1, B46. wsc.toml [gates] dirs and game gate modules with the verb contract (NAME, run(ctx) -> Result) run by wsc gates (B1); then move brief_problems, queue_problems, policy_problems, view_panel and summary (warscape/hooks.py) onto that contract, with a migration path for napoleon's hook module (B46). Opus: a new extension point every game builds on, plus a migration of the pipeline's live hooks (C18).
title: Game-specific gates, and the five hook names as gate modules
